name: catch fish

text: Two fish, flapping in the grass.
Two fish from the same pool.
One fish, flapping on the bank.
A single fish, heavy for its size.
Nothing. The current carries them off.
Nothing. They slip back into the deep water.
The spear comes up with weed, nothing else.

log: You stand on a stone above a slow pool, spear raised.
You wade into the river to your knees and wait.
Under the willows you wait for a fish to hold still.
